description: The main window; it draws its own title bar (drag, minimise, maximise, close) and opens web, mail and phone links (not "show in folder": the app does that itself, for its own files only). Only the core parts the page uses (app: version, Android's Back; event: the app's notices and file drops; window: its own buttons), not core:default (no image, menu, tray, path or resources)
